Detail: Each reference clip has a matching target clip (empty scene -> scene with bird)
Reference and target must have the same length and resolution
Keep indoor pairs and outdoor pairs SEPARATE
People, text, watermarks, other animals (unless that is the bird you want)
Prefer locked-off shots or slow pans
About 20-40 clean pairs per domain (sky, then house) beats hundreds of messy clips
True house-interior bird clips are rare. Use cage/pet parrot clips, film a pet bird, or composite a bird onto empty rooms
